links.comparator_used: Baseline LLMs such as GPT-4o generating ICFs from trial protocols without the retrieval-augmented, human-in-the-loop pipeline
links.outcome: Regulatory compliance and factual accuracy of LLM-generated informed consent forms
links.effect: Baseline GPT-4o reached 70%-80% compliance with factual errors in 18%-43% of cases; InformGen reached nearly 100% regulatory compliance and over 90% factual accuracy
links.quote: In contrast, InformGen substantially improved outputs, achieving nearly 100% regulatory compliance and over 90% factual accuracy, as validated by 5 domain-expert annotators.
